fullText.simplified:
第一章、市长先生想见您

    三百年前，有个年轻的读书人，名字叫戴利。他长得不错，学习很好。他爱旅游，喜欢看书，特别是一些关于神仙的书。
    戴利觉得世上有神仙，而且神仙就住在离世人不远的地方。戴利去过很多地方，在看完了自己生活的世界以后，他会想：神仙们生活的世界是什么样子的呢？他觉得那一定是个极美的地方。
    当然，除了美，戴利更羡慕神仙的是他们可以长生不老。人最多只能活七八十岁，超过百岁的人极少，而神仙的生命没有结束的时候，这是多么让人羡慕的事情啊！虽然戴利也爱自己的生活，但他更想长生不老，所以他特别想成为一个让人羡慕的神仙。
    人怎样才能成为神仙呢？有这样的办法吗？戴利不知道，世人都不知道。戴利想书里可能有答案。他找了很多关于神仙的书，从早看到晚。他看得太认真了，有时会忘记吃饭和睡觉。
    有个冬天的上午，外面下着大雪，他在家里看书，看着看着就睡着了。不知道睡了多久，他听到有个人叫他：“戴先生，戴先生，快醒醒……”
    戴利醒了，他看到书桌前站着一个人。这个人好像是他家的下人，但是他又不认识，因为他家的下人实在太多了。那个人看到他醒了，马上高兴地说：“戴先生，您醒了，太好了！市长先生有个问题想问您，他想见您，您能和我一起去见见他吗？”
    “市长先生想见我？他有什么问题？”戴利有点儿吃惊。
    “市长先生说您去了就知道了，时间有点儿急，您能现在就和我走吗？”下人好像很着急。
    “好吧！“戴利穿好衣服，跟下人出门了。
fullText.traditional:
第一章、市長先生想見您

    三百年前，有個年輕的讀書人，名字叫戴利。他長得不錯，學習很好。他愛旅遊，喜歡看書，特別是一些關於神仙的書。
    戴利覺得世上有神仙，而且神仙就住在離世人不遠的地方。戴利去過很多地方，在看完了自己生活的世界以後，他會想：神仙們生活的世界是什麼樣子的呢？他覺得那一定是個極美的地方。
    當然，除了美，戴利更羨慕神仙的是他們可以長生不老。人最多只能活七八十歲，超過百歲的人極少，而神仙的生命沒有結束的時候，這是多麼讓人羨慕的事情啊！雖然戴利也愛自己的生活，但他更想長生不老，所以他特別想成為一個讓人羨慕的神仙。
    人怎樣才能成為神仙呢？有這樣的辦法嗎？戴利不知道，世人都不知道。戴利想書裡可能有答案。他找了很多關於神仙的書，從早看到晚。他看得太認真了，有時會忘記吃飯和睡覺。
    有個冬天的上午，外面下著大雪，他在家裡看書，看著看著就睡著了。不知道睡了多久，他聽到有個人叫他：“戴先生，戴先生，快醒醒……”
    戴利醒了，他看到書桌前站著一個人。這個人好像是他家的下人，但是他又不認識，因為他家的下人實在太多了。那個人看到他醒了，馬上高興地說：“戴先生，您醒了，太好了！市長先生有個問題想問您，他想見您，您能和我一起去見見他嗎？”
    “市長先生想見我？他有什麼問題？”戴利有點兒吃驚。
    “市長先生說您去了就知道了，時間有點兒急，您能現在就和我走嗎？”下人好像很著急。
    “好吧！“戴利穿好衣服，跟下人出門了。

sentences.traditional: 三百年前，有個年輕的讀書人，名字叫戴利。
sentences.pinyin: sān bǎi nián qián yǒu ge nián qīng de dú shū rén míng zi jiào dài lì
sentences.english: Three hundred years ago, there was a young scholar by the name of Dai Li.

sentences.simplified: 他长得不错，学习很好。他爱旅游，喜欢看书，特别是一些关于神仙的书。
sentences.traditional: 他長得不錯，學習很好。他愛旅遊，喜歡看書，特別是一些關於神仙的書。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǎng de bú cuò xué xí hěn hǎo tā ài lǚ yóu xǐ huan kàn shū tè bié shì yì xiē guān yú shén xiān de shū
sentences.english: He was good-looking and also a good student. He loved to travel and liked to read, especially some books about immortals.

sentences.simplified: 戴利觉得世上有神仙，而且神仙就住在离世人不远的地方。
sentences.traditional: 戴利覺得世上有神仙，而且神仙就住在離世人不遠的地方。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì jué de shì shàng yǒu shén xiān ér qiě shén xiān jiù zhù zài lí shì rén bù yuǎn de dì fang
sentences.english: Dai Li thought that there were immortals in the world and that the immortals lived not far from regular people.

sentences.simplified: 戴利去过很多地方，在看完了自己生活的世界以后，他会想：
sentences.traditional: 戴利去過很多地方，在看完了自己生活的世界以後，他會想：
sentences.pinyin: dài lì qù guò hěn duō dì fang zài kàn wán le zì jǐ shēng huó de shì jiè yǐ hòu tā huì xiǎng
sentences.english: Dai Li had been to many places. After he had finished seeing the world that he lived in, he would wonder:

sentences.simplified: 神仙们生活的世界是什么样子的呢？他觉得那一定是个极美的地方。
sentences.traditional: 神仙們生活的世界是什麼樣子的呢？他覺得那一定是個極美的地方。
sentences.pinyin: shén xiān men shēng huó de shì jiè shì shén me yàng zi de ne tā jué de nà yí dìng shì ge jí měi de dì fang
sentences.english: What is the world where the immortals live like? He thought it must be an extremely beautiful place.

sentences.simplified: 当然，除了美，戴利更羡慕神仙的是他们可以长生不老。
sentences.traditional: 當然，除了美，戴利更羨慕神仙的是他們可以長生不老。
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán chú le měi dài lì gèng xiàn mù shén xiān de shì tā men kě yǐ cháng shēng bù lǎo
sentences.english: Of course, as well as beauty, Dai Li was even more envious that the immortals could live forever and not grow old.

sentences.simplified: 人最多只能活七八十岁，超过百岁的人极少，
sentences.traditional: 人最多只能活七八十歲，超過百歲的人極少，
sentences.pinyin: rén zuì duō zhǐ néng huó qī bā shí suì chāo guò bǎi suì de rén jí shǎo
sentences.english: Humans can only live until they are 70 or 80. Very few people are more than 100 years old.

sentences.simplified: 而神仙的生命没有结束的时候，这是多么让人羡慕的事情啊！
sentences.traditional: 而神仙的生命沒有結束的時候，這是多麼讓人羨慕的事情啊！
sentences.pinyin: ér shén xiān de shēng mìng méi yǒu jié shù de shí hou zhè shì duō me ràng rén xiàn mù de shì qing a
sentences.english: But the lives of immortals have no end. What a thing for humans to be envious of!

sentences.simplified: 虽然戴利也爱自己的生活，但他更想长生不老，
sentences.traditional: 雖然戴利也愛自己的生活，但他更想長生不老，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán dài lì yě ài zì jǐ de shēng huó dàn tā gèng xiǎng cháng shēng bù lǎo
sentences.english: Although Dai Li also loved his life, he wanted to live forever and not grow old even more.

sentences.simplified: 所以他特别想成为一个让人羡慕的神仙。
sentences.traditional: 所以他特別想成為一個讓人羨慕的神仙。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā tè bié xiǎng chéng wéi yí ge ràng rén xiàn mù de shén xiān
sentences.english: So he especially wanted to become an immortal envied by humans.

sentences.simplified: 人怎样才能成为神仙呢？有这样的办法吗？
sentences.traditional: 人怎樣才能成為神仙呢？有這樣的辦法嗎？
sentences.pinyin: rén zěn yàng cái néng chéng wéi shén xiān ne yǒu zhè yàng de bàn fǎ ma
sentences.english: How could a human become an immortal? Was there a way to do this?

sentences.simplified: 戴利不知道，世人都不知道。戴利想书里可能有答案。
sentences.traditional: 戴利不知道，世人都不知道。戴利想書裡可能有答案。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì bù zhī dào shì rén dōu bù zhī dào dài lì xiǎng shū lǐ kě néng yǒu dá àn
sentences.english: Dai Li didn’t know. No one in the world knew. Dai Li thought that a book might have the answer.

sentences.simplified: 他找了很多关于神仙的书，从早看到晚。
sentences.traditional: 他找了很多關於神仙的書，從早看到晚。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǎo le hěn duō guān yú shén xiān de shū cóng zǎo kàn dào wǎn
sentences.english: He searched for books about immortals and read them from morning to night.

sentences.simplified: 他看得太认真了，有时会忘记吃饭和睡觉。
sentences.traditional: 他看得太認真了，有時會忘記吃飯和睡覺。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn de tài rèn zhēn le yǒu shí huì wàng jì chī fàn hé shuì jiào
sentences.english: He read so intensely that he sometimes forgot to eat and sleep.

sentences.simplified: 有个冬天的上午，外面下着大雪，他在家里看书，看着看着就睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 有個冬天的上午，外面下著大雪，他在家裡看書，看著看著就睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu ge dōng tiān de shàng wǔ wài miàn xià zhe dà xuě tā zài jiā lǐ kàn shū kàn zhe kàn zhe jiù shuì zháo le
sentences.english: One winter morning, it was snowing heavily outside. He was at home reading a book and fell asleep reading it.

sentences.simplified: 不知道睡了多久，他听到有个人叫他：“戴先生，戴先生，快醒醒……”
sentences.traditional: 不知道睡了多久，他聽到有個人叫他：“戴先生，戴先生，快醒醒……”
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào shuì le duō jiǔ tā tīng dào yǒu ge rén jiào tā dài xiān sheng dài xiān sheng kuài xǐng xǐng
sentences.english: Dai Li didn’t know how long he had slept when he heard someone call out to him: “Mr. Dai, Mr. Dai, wake up …”

sentences.simplified: 戴利醒了，他看到书桌前站着一个人。
sentences.traditional: 戴利醒了，他看到書桌前站著一個人。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì xǐng le tā kàn dào shū zhuō qián zhàn zhe yí ge rén
sentences.english: Dai Li woke up. He saw a man standing in front of his desk.

sentences.simplified: 这个人好像是他家的下人，但是他又不认识，因为他家的下人实在太多了。
sentences.traditional: 這個人好像是他家的下人，但是他又不認識，因為他家的下人實在太多了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rén hǎo xiàng shì tā jiā de xià rén dàn shì tā yòu bú rèn shi yīn wèi tā jiā de xià rén shí zài tài duō le
sentences.english: This man seemed to be his family’s servant, but he still didn’t recognize him because his family really had too many servants.

sentences.simplified: 那个人看到他醒了，马上高兴地说：
sentences.traditional: 那個人看到他醒了，馬上高興地說：
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén kàn dào tā xǐng le mǎ shàng gāo xìng de shuō
sentences.english: The man saw that he was awake and immediately said happily, ..

sentences.simplified: “戴先生，您醒了，太好了！市长先生有个问题想问您，
sentences.traditional: “戴先生，您醒了，太好了！市長先生有個問題想問您，
sentences.pinyin: dài xiān sheng nín xǐng le tài hǎo le shì zhǎng xiān sheng yǒu ge wèn tí xiǎng wèn nín
sentences.english: .. “Mr. Dai, you’re awake. That’s great! The mayor has a question he wants to ask you.

sentences.simplified: 他想见您，您能和我一起去见见他吗？”
sentences.traditional: 他想見您，您能和我一起去見見他嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng jiàn nín nín néng hé wǒ yì qǐ qù jiàn jiàn tā ma
sentences.english: He wants to see you. Can you come with me to meet him?”

sentences.simplified: “市长先生想见我？他有什么问题？”戴利有点儿吃惊。
sentences.traditional: “市長先生想見我？他有什麼問題？”戴利有點兒吃驚。
sentences.pinyin: shì zhǎng xiān sheng xiǎng jiàn wǒ tā yǒu shén me wèn tí dài lì yǒu diǎn'r chī jīng
sentences.english: “The mayor wants to see me? What question does he have?” Dai Li was a little taken aback.

sentences.simplified: “市长先生说您去了就知道了，时间有点儿急，您能现在就和我走吗？”
sentences.traditional: “市長先生說您去了就知道了，時間有點兒急，您能現在就和我走嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: shì zhǎng xiān sheng shuō nín qù le jiù zhī dào le shí jiān yǒu diǎn'r jí nín néng xiàn zài jiù hé wǒ zǒu ma
sentences.english: “The mayor said you will find out when you get there. It’s quite urgent. Can you leave with me right now?”

sentences.simplified: 下人好像很着急。
sentences.traditional: 下人好像很著急。
sentences.pinyin: xià rén hǎo xiàng hěn zháo jí
sentences.english: The servant seemed to be very anxious.

sentences.simplified: “好吧！“戴利穿好衣服，跟下人出门了。
sentences.traditional: “好吧！“戴利穿好衣服，跟下人出門了。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo ba dài lì chuān hǎo yī fu gēn xià rén chū mén le
sentences.english: “All right!” Dai Li got dressed and left his home with the servant.

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: The Mayor Wants to See You
Three hundred years ago, there was a young scholar by the name of Dai Li.
He was good-looking and also a good student. He loved to travel and liked to read, especially some books about immortals.
Dai Li thought that there were immortals in the world and that the immortals lived not far from regular people.
Dai Li had been to many places. After he had finished seeing the world that he lived in, he would wonder:
What is the world where the immortals live like? He thought it must be an extremely beautiful place.
Of course, as well as beauty, Dai Li was even more envious that the immortals could live forever and not grow old.
Humans can only live until they are 70 or 80. Very few people are more than 100 years old.
But the lives of immortals have no end. What a thing for humans to be envious of!
Although Dai Li also loved his life, he wanted to live forever and not grow old even more.
So he especially wanted to become an immortal envied by humans.
How could a human become an immortal? Was there a way to do this?
Dai Li didn’t know. No one in the world knew. Dai Li thought that a book might have the answer.
He searched for books about immortals and read them from morning to night.
He read so intensely that he sometimes forgot to eat and sleep.
One winter morning, it was snowing heavily outside. He was at home reading a book and fell asleep reading it.
Dai Li didn’t know how long he had slept when he heard someone call out to him: “Mr. Dai, Mr. Dai, wake up …”
Dai Li woke up. He saw a man standing in front of his desk.
This man seemed to be his family’s servant, but he still didn’t recognize him because his family really had too many servants.
The man saw that he was awake and immediately said happily, ..
.. “Mr. Dai, you’re awake. That’s great! The mayor has a question he wants to ask you.
He wants to see you. Can you come with me to meet him?”
“The mayor wants to see me? What question does he have?” Dai Li was a little taken aback.
“The mayor said you will find out when you get there. It’s quite urgent. Can you leave with me right now?”
The servant seemed to be very anxious.
“All right!” Dai Li got dressed and left his home with the servant.
